name: GitLab MCP
description: Curated GitLab REST API v4 collection with 25 MCP tools (GitLab.com and self-managed).

variables.name: gitlab_base_url
variables.description: GitLab instance base URL without a trailing slash (GitLab.com or self-managed, optional sub-path)

variables.name: gitlab_project
variables.description: Default GitLab project: numeric ID or full path

variables.name: gitlab_token
variables.description: GitLab personal, project or group access token

requests.name: GitLab Get Current User
requests.mcp_description: Return the GitLab user that owns the configured access token.

requests.name: GitLab List Projects
requests.mcp_description: List or search GitLab projects visible to the token (paginated). Each project has a numeric id and a path_with_namespace usable as gitlab_project.

search.description: Optional text matched against project names and paths.

membership.description: Optional: true limits results to projects the user is a member of; false (default) lists all visible projects.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitLab max 100). Defaults to 20.

requests.name: GitLab Get Project
requests.mcp_description: Get one GitLab project. Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

requests.name: GitLab List Branches
requests.mcp_description: List repository branches (paginated). Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

search.description: Optional text matched against branch names.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitLab max 100). Defaults to 20.

requests.name: GitLab Get Branch
requests.mcp_description: Get one repository branch with its latest commit. Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

branch.description: Branch name, e.g. main or feature/x (slashes are encoded automatically).

requests.name: GitLab Get File
requests.mcp_description: Read the raw content of one repository file. Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

file_path.description: Repository file path, e.g. src/app/main.py (slashes and reserved characters are encoded automatically).

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA; defaults to the project's HEAD.

requests.name: GitLab List Repository Tree
requests.mcp_description: List files and directories in the repository tree (paginated). Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

path.description: Optional directory path inside the repository.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA; defaults to the default branch.

recursive.description: Optional: true lists the tree recursively; false (default) lists one level.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitLab max 100). Defaults to 20.

requests.name: GitLab List Commits
requests.mcp_description: List repository commits, optionally filtered by ref and path (paginated). Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

ref_name.description: Optional branch, tag or SHA to list commits from; defaults to the default branch.

path.description: Optional file or directory path; only commits touching it are listed.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp; only commits after it.

until.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp; only commits before it.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitLab max 100). Defaults to 20.

requests.name: GitLab Get Commit
requests.mcp_description: Get one commit. Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

sha.description: Commit SHA, branch name or tag name.

requests.name: GitLab List Issues
requests.mcp_description: List project issues (paginated). Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

state.description: Optional state filter: opened, closed or all.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated label names; issues must have all of them.

search.description: Optional text matched against issue titles and descriptions.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitLab max 100). Defaults to 20.

requests.name: GitLab Get Issue
requests.mcp_description: Get one project issue by IID. Uses the endpoint's gitlab_project (numeric ID or full path, e.g. group/subgroup/project); pass gitlab_project to target another project; if no default is configured you must pass it.

issue_iid.description: Project-scoped issue IID (the number shown in the UI, not the global ID); decimal string or integer.
